projects.title: Set Operation Explorer
bullets: Contributed to a team set operation explorer project by translating discrete mathematical definitions into Python program functions.
Constructed examples and counterexamples for the represented rules and explained the connection between formal definitions and their implementation.

projects.title: Course Enrolment Records
bullets: Contributed to a team course enrolment records project by designing related tables and key constraints in SQLite.
Checked missing values and duplicate records, and wrote SQL queries joining and aggregating sample enrolment records.
